title: ci(lint): every job in lint.yml carries a timeout-minutes derived from its measured duration
body:
Fixes #21050
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`.github/workflows/lint.yml` gains five `timeout-minutes` keys, each under a comment carrying its measurement and the derivation rule. Nothing else moves: no job `name:`, step, `needs:`, `if:`, `permissions:` or `concurrency:` changes. The diff against d1f8ce8 is 62 insertions, 0 deletions, in five hunks, each directly under a job's `runs-on:` line (two commits: 5e6d90c, then 51f3743 for the ruled patch round).

| job id | check context (`name:`, byte-identical) | `timeout-minutes` before | after | measured p50 / p99 / max (min), n |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `lint` | `Lint & Repo Gates` (required) | none, so GitHub's default 360 | **55** | 15.8 / 32.6 / 32.7, 81 |
| `typecheck-workspace` | `Type Check · workspace` | none | **30** | 13.0 / 16.0 / 16.0, 86 |
| `typecheck-consumers` | `Type Check · consumer gates` | none | **20** | 7.7 / 10.1 / 10.1, 87 |
| `typecheck-debt` | `Type Check · debt ledger` | none | **15** | 5.8 / 7.4 / 7.5, 92 |
| `typecheck-source-gates` | `Type Check · source gates` | none | **10** | 3.2 / 3.5 / 3.7, 94 |
| `typecheck` | `TypeScript Type Check` (required) | 10 | 10 (line untouched) | 0.1 / 0.1 / 0.2, 85 |

Measurement (the card's, transcribed into the comments): the 100 most recent completed `lint.yml` runs, 2026-10-01T00:23Z to 03:24Z, 96 runs read, 525 successful job rows, job `started_at` to `completed_at` from the jobs API. Rule: about 2x the measured maximum, rounded to a 5-minute grain, never below 10 minutes, never above the merge queue's 60-minute `check_response_timeout_minutes`. For `lint` the window binds rather than 2x, and the wall sits below it, at 55, leaving 22 minutes (1.7x) over the measured maximum. The `lint` comment carries the full reasoning; the four lane comments are short and point at it.

## Why

`Lint & Repo Gates` is the longest required check in every merge-queue group, and nothing in this workflow bounds a step that stops producing output: no step runs under `scripts/run-with-stall-guard.mjs`, so the job timeout is the only wall these jobs can have, and five of six declared none. A silent step would hold the job `in_progress` until GitHub's 360-minute default, while the queue (ruleset 12119582) gives up on the entry at 60 minutes with no failing check to read and no `Merge Queue Triage` comment, and the hung job keeps a runner for up to five more hours.

## What GitHub does at the wall: documented, plus one reading on this repository

No local test can drive a job timeout. GitHub documents that a job exceeding `timeout-minutes` is cancelled. One reading on this repository agrees, read this session from the jobs and check-runs APIs: in run 36803445860 (`CI`, `merge_group`), job `Test Core (1/6)`, stopped by its 45-minute wall, has `conclusion: cancelled` and a `failure`-level annotation reading `The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 45m0s`. For the four type-check lanes, a `cancelled` lane fails the required `TypeScript Type Check` aggregate (its verdict step fails on anything but `success`). For `lint`, `cancelled` is the conclusion of the required context itself.

Ruleset 12119582, read this session: `merge_queue.check_response_timeout_minutes: 60`, and its required contexts include `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check`.

## Verification (head 51f3743, base d1f8ce8)

- **Structure.** The file parses under PyYAML 6.0.1 and js-yaml 5.4.2. A per-job fingerprint (name, step count, SHA-256 over every key except `timeout-minutes`, plus the top-level keys and the job order) is identical before and after except for the five `timeout-minutes` values. `actionlint` is not on the PATH; nothing was installed.
- **Mechanism assumption A1.** `git grep -c 'run-with-stall-guard' -- .github/workflows/lint.yml` answers 1, not 0. The hit is prose in the `Stall-guard self-test` step's comment, and no step runs under the guard. `pnpm check:stall-guard-budget` exits 0: 39 workflow files, 65 jobs, 730 steps, 10 guard-wrapped steps, none of them in this file.
- **Mechanism assumption A2.** `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` (and its `--self-test`), `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` (7 required contexts pinned across 3 workflows) and `node scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs --self-test` all exit 0 on this diff.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived the change set from git against merge base d1f8ce865 and printed 44 commands. 43 exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (1976 cases, 680 s). `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exits 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its `--re-measure` half needs the built package closure, so it is **NOT MEASURED** locally, and CI runs it in the `Type Check · debt ledger` lane. Its `--self-test` half passed, and `pnpm check:type-check-coverage`, which reads this file, exits 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 44 accounted, 43 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. 15 of the 44 are `--self-test`-only commands that judge their own script, not this diff.
- **Named and dispatch-time extras**, all exit 0: `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs` (no citations added), `pnpm check:stall-guard`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`, `pnpm check:route-ledger-census`, `pnpm check:select-shard-packages`, `node scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs --self-test`, `node scripts/pr-labels.mjs --self-test`.
- **Prose.** The added lines carry no tracker number and no model identifier, and no raw control bytes.
- **Patch round at 51f3743.** `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`, `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` and `pnpm check:stall-guard-budget` all exit 0. The file parses under PyYAML and js-yaml. The structural fingerprint against d1f8ce8 differs only in the five added `timeout-minutes` values (55/10/30/15/20), and the aggregate's 10 is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Floor clause (ruled).** The rule's floor is a flat 10 minutes, which all six values meet. The earlier maximum-plus-10 wording, which four values did not meet, was dropped from the `lint` comment on the seat's ruling.
- **Clock ordering (ruled).** A job's wall starts when a runner picks the job up, which is after the queue's 60-minute check-response window has opened, so a wall equal to that window would let the queue remove a hung entry before the check turns `cancelled`. On the seat's ruling the `lint` wall is 55. The `cancelled` check and its annotation land before the queue's window closes whenever pickup takes under five minutes, so the removal is attributable to a visible failing check. 55 leaves 22 minutes (1.7x) over the measured maximum of 32.7.
- **Merge Queue Triage scope.** It subscribes to the `CI` workflow only (`workflow_run`, `workflows: [CI]`), not `Lint & Type Check`, and fires on `failure` only. A timed-out lint job gets no triage comment either way. Its header scopes it to "every red merge_group CI run", so this is its declared scope, not a defect. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.
- **Card location detail.** The card places the `Stall-guard budget invariant` step in the `lint` job, but it sits in `typecheck-source-gates`. That has no effect on this change.

`skip-changeset` applies: `.github/workflows/` publishes nothing, so no changeset was created and the seat applies the label.
